adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, `discourse_expires_in 1.minute` is executed regardless of whether a topic was found or the `loading` template was rendered. When no topic exists yet, the controller enqueues `:retrieve_topic` and renders `loading`, but that loading response will also be cacheable for 60s. Since `loading.html.erb` triggers a reload after 30s, an intermediary cache or the browser can legitimately serve the cached loading page for up to the full minute, delaying discovery of the newly-created topic and potentially causing repeated cached loading responses until expiry.
